content.text:
* OTA-PRECISION-SKY130
* Two-stage Miller OTA, precision biased.
*  - NMOS input pair at very low current density (deep subthreshold: low
*    Vgs for input-common-mode headroom down to VIN=0.75V at -40C),
*    cascoded by NMOS cascodes whose gates sit on the stacked-diode IBIAS
*    node.  This matches the input-pair drain voltages (small systematic
*    offset) and raises the first-stage gain.
*  - PMOS current-mirror load (long channel: high ro).
*  - PMOS common-source second stage = exact 4x replica of the mirror
*    device (same W/L, same current density => same Vsg => drain voltages
*    of input pair and mirror matched => low offset).
*  - NMOS current-source load = exact 4x replica of the reference device,
*    cascoded (cascode gate on IBIAS): load current independent of VOUT,
*    which keeps the offset from drifting with the output level.
*  - stacked NMOS reference from the 10uA IBIAS pin: Q = Vgs (tail/load
*    gate), IBIAS = 2*Vgs (cascode gates); both supply independent.
*  - Miller compensation Rz+Cc (LHP zero, well damped).
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS

* ---- stacked reference (10uA): Q ~0.5V, IBIAS ~1.0V (0.1uA/square)
XMREF2 IBIAS IBIAS Q VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMREF  Q Q VSS VSS      sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=1 nf=1 m=1

* ---- tail current source : 2x = 20uA
XMTAIL TAILN Q VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=1 nf=1 m=2

* ---- second-stage load : 4x = 40uA, cascoded
XMLOAD  Y Q VSS VSS     sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=1 nf=1 m=4
XMLOADC VOUT IBIAS Y VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=20 L=1 nf=1 m=1

* ---- input pair (10uA each), low density, cascoded
XMINN N1 VINN TAILN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=1 nf=1 m=2
XMINP N2 VINP TAILN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=1 nf=1 m=2
XMINNC GC IBIAS N1 VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=20 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMINPC XN IBIAS N2 VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=20 L=1 nf=1 m=1

* ---- PMOS mirror load (10uA each)
XMP3 GC GC VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=40 L=4 nf=1 m=1
XMP4 XN GC VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=40 L=4 nf=1 m=1

* ---- second stage PMOS: 4x replica of MP3 (40uA), same W/L and density
XMP6 VOUT XN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=40 L=4 nf=1 m=4

* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor
RZ XN XC 1.5k
CC XC VOUT 15p

.ends DUT
